newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to struggle, support at 127.01.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to struggle, support at 127.01.

text.p: June BTPs will struggle to make much headway on Tuesday with any rallies petering out in the face of convincing selling pressure, technical analysts said.
Technical Data fixed income analyst Louise Jones put support for the June contract at 126.99, 127.01 -- a former congestion area from early April.
"Below there there's no great significant level until a rough double bottom around 126.50,54, an intra-day double bottom from April 8...which is also a low from early March," she said.
By 0801 GMT, June BTPs were up two basis points at 127.41, off a low of 127.13 and a high of 127.55.
"BTPs may have some upside on the benign CPI data released yesterday...but any rally will meet with fairly convincing selling pressure long term," said Jones.
On Monday, preliminary data from six Italian cities pointed to inflation falling to 1.8 percent year-on-year in April from 2.2 percent in March.
On the upside, Jones put minor resistance at 127.57, an intraday stall level. "It could extend from there, but 128.20 is the only next thing of note."
Analysts at a European bank said Monday's third consecutive negative session in BTPs suggested further weakness in store.
"Oscillators in 'sell', low closing price and even lower APT close suggest further weakness, confirmed by the failure to breach resistance at 128.15," they said.
"Below 127.00, the target would be at 126.50, where we see buying opportunity as well as around 126.00."
By 0820 GMT, June Eurolire were up three basis points at 93.14, off an early high of 93.17.
Analysts said a break below trendline resistance and a sell signal in stochastics gave Eurolire a bearish tone.
